title: Mongolian Beef
description: A delicious dish with sliced beef, paired with vegetables and savory sauce, usually served over rice.
instructions: Slice beef and marinate in 1tsp soy sauce, 1tsp vegetable oil, and 1/8tsp baking soda for 30 minutes.
Mix brown sugar, 1/4 cup hot water, 1tsp soy sauce, 1tsp cornstarch, and 1/8tsp baking soda in a bowl to make the sauce.
Heat 2/3 cup vegetable oil in a wok over high heat, add in beef slices, sear for 1 minute intil crispy coating is accomplished, transfer onto plate.
in the same wok, use 2 tbls of oil behind, and add ginger, peppers, garlic, and scallions, stor for 30 seconds then add sauce cook until thickened enough to coat the back of a spoon
add in beef, toss for 30 seconds, plate and serve with rice.
